# Report Decoded

> Report Decoded is an Australian tool that turns a building and pest inspection report (PDF, AS4349.1) into a plain-English verdict, repair-cost estimates for every defect, a ready-to-send negotiation letter, and locally matched tradies — in under 2 minutes. One report is $39 (no subscription). It helps property buyers understand what their inspection report actually means and what to negotiate before they commit.

## What it does
- Reads any Australian building, pest, or combined inspection report (AS4349.1)
- Gives a Proceed / Negotiate / Walk Away verdict with a plain-English summary
- Estimates repair cost ranges for every defect (2026 Australian rates)
- Classifies defects by real severity (major vs minor, safety hazards)
- Drafts a negotiation letter with a defensible dollar figure
- Cites every finding to the exact page of the inspector's PDF

## Key pages
- [Report Decoded home](https://www.reportdecoded.com.au): upload a report, see the offer and a sample
- [For buyer's agents](https://www.reportdecoded.com.au/agents): unlimited reports, white-label PDF, dashboard
